paper_style.palette_strategy: 正文表格以黑白规则、粗体/下划线和浅灰 group band 为主；Figure 2/3 使用 pastel categorical 条形色，Figure 5–8 使用蓝白红 consistency heatmap，Figure 1/4/9–11 使用深蓝、截图和状态色。颜色主要承担类别/状态角色，图内直接标签提供部分冗余。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: PDF 是 vector/raster mixed：正文、规则、表头、Figure 2/3/9 的文字与几何多数为矢量；Figure 1/4/10/11 含截图和 PNG，Figure 5–8 含栅格 colorbar/图像组件，Table 9 含网页截图。
paper_style.style_consistency: PDF 正文、caption 与 native table 共享 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern、单栏 Letter 版面和极简横线；图内使用 DejaVu Sans/Arial/Calibri/Comic Sans 等多套嵌入字体，截图/流程图风格差异明显，因此表格系统一致、图内系统中等一致。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Overview of WebDevJudge. Left: Data Collection with query-based and environment-based filtering. Center: Preference label annotation with verifiable rubric tree. Right: Evaluate (M)LLM-based and agentic evaluators under pairwise and single-answer paradigms.

color.semantic_mapping: 深蓝标题条标记 Data Collection、Annotate with Rubric、Judge；青蓝、米色和浅蓝框分别标记 query/filter、rubric 节点、code/rendered web 与 interaction；颜色与文字、位置和虚线框共同编码模块。

encodings.x: 左→右三栏：Data Collection、Annotate with Rubric、Judge。
encodings.color: 模块角色、输入/输出和 verdict 状态。
encodings.shape: rounded boxes、截图、箭头和 rubric tree 节点。
encodings.line: 实线/虚线边框与箭头表示过滤、验证和评测流。
encodings.facet: 三栏流程与 Judge 内 Pairwise/Single 两个 facet。
encodings.text: Q、W_a、W_b、L_p、模型名、模块标签与 verdict。

figures.data_and_statistics: 示意图不编码样本、分母、聚合或不确定性；正文给出最终 654 个实例、269/276/109 标签分布，图只定义 data→annotation→judge 接口。公开仓库的 assets/overview.png（4487×1725）与 PDF Figure 1 的三栏结构和截图匹配，但不能恢复数值绘图参数。
figures.evidence_relation: 数据构造与过滤主张 → Figure 1 左栏；query-grounded rubric tree 与三维叶节点 → 中栏；code/screenshot/interaction 观察和 pairwise/single 协议 → 右栏；Table 1–2 回收标签质量与类别，Table 3–7 回收评测结果。
design_strengths: 三栏空间顺序把方法接口压缩成可复读的单向路径。
截图、直接标签、颜色和虚线框对输入角色形成冗余编码。
Judge 栏同时呈现 evaluator、observation、agentic 和 paradigm，能把后续表格放回流程。
design_weaknesses: 内部图标、截图和手写风格字体在缩放后接近可读性下限。
颜色语义依赖英文标签，灰度下模块角色区分明显减弱。
流程没有显示样本数量、rubric 权重或阶段错误率，不能单独支撑可靠性结论。
figures.reusable_pattern: 复用“数据过滤 → query-grounded annotation → evaluator/observation/paradigm”三栏骨架；每个模块同时用直接文字和角色色编码，并在底部保留最终数据对象接口。

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: Agreement rates of LLM evaluators under various guidance protocols. We compare pairwise and single-answer paradigms using direct judgment, Likert scales, and structured rubrics.

color.semantic_mapping: 五个系列分别是 Pair Rubric、Pair Likert、Pair Direct、Single Rubric、Single Likert；斜线 hatch 进一步区分两个 single 系列。

encodings.x: 六个 evaluator 模型的 categorical x 轴。
encodings.y: Agreement Rate (%)，约 40–70 的线性 y 轴。
encodings.shape: 垂直矩形条；single 系列带斜线。
encodings.facet: 按模型分组，每组包含 Pair 与 Single 协议。
encodings.text: 每个条顶部直接标出百分比；底部 legend 定义系列。

figures.data_and_statistics: 六个模型、五个协议共 30 个 agreement-rate point estimates；值约在 54.6–71.2，正文举例 GPT-4.1 Pair Rubric/Likert/Direct=70.0/70.3/68.7、Single Rubric/Likert=65.6/60.9，DeepSeek-R1 single Rubric/Likert=63.5/54.6。无重复、误差或区间。y 轴从 40 开始。
figures.evidence_relation: Table 3 的 single/pair 主比较 → Figure 3 的 Direct/Likert/Rubric guidance 对照 → §4.2 关于 pairwise 中 guidance 边际收益和 single 中 rubric 优势的解释；Table 14 提供去 tie 后的补充。
design_strengths: 同一模型内的五个 bar 直接回答 protocol 对比问题。
数值直接标在 bar 顶部，legend 位于图底且与 bar 色/纹理一致。
统一 y 轴和模型顺序，便于发现 pairwise 通常高于 single。
design_weaknesses: 截断 y 轴会放大约 1–3 个百分点差异。
颜色和 hatch 仍要求读 legend，灰度下 rubric/likert 的区分变弱。
caption 没有给出样本量、分母或 tie 处理规则。
figures.reusable_pattern: 使用“模型分组 × 协议系列”的直接标注 grouped bar；当颜色表达协议时，用 hatch 或标签给 single/pair 提供冗余。

figures.label: Figure 4

caption.text: Figure 4: An example illustrating the failure to recognize functional equivalence. The webpage element for “Presentation” serves the same purpose as the required “Demonstration” rating. Detailed examples can be found in Appendix F.2.

color.semantic_mapping: 黑蓝边框和文字是结构；浅红表示 LLM/Agent false，浅绿表示 Human true，截图区域用浅灰底。状态同时写成 false/true。

encodings.x: 横向区域按 Instruction→Requirement/Element→LLM/Agent/Human verdict 排列。
encodings.y: 垂直层级表示任务条件、实现证据和三类评测结论。
encodings.color: 粉/绿 verdict 状态与灰色截图/说明框。
encodings.shape: 虚线框、截图和 verdict 条。
encodings.line: 实线外框与虚线内部边界表示证据层级。

figures.data_and_statistics: 一个功能等价案例：要求是 “Demonstration” rating row，网页提供同功能的 “Presentation” row；LLM=false、Agent=false、Human=true。它是单案例 point judgment，不报告该错误的 prevalence、分母或不确定性。
figures.evidence_relation: §4.3 functional-equivalence 瓶颈 → Figure 4 的 literal wording 对照 → Appendix F.2 Figure 10 的模型输出展开；与 Table 6 feasibility 的定量诊断共同支撑“语义/执行理解是瓶颈”。
design_strengths: 把抽象的 functional equivalence 错误绑定到一个可检查的 requirement/element 对。
verdict 文字和颜色冗余编码，读者不必读取所有截图即可看到结论。
同一画布同时放 instruction、网页证据和评测输出，因果顺序清楚。
design_weaknesses: 只有一个代表性案例，无法代表总体错误率。
截图和大段说明字体混杂，缩放时局部细节难读。
粉/绿语义仍依赖颜色，caption 没有定义 verdict 颜色或评测协议。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用“要求—实现—判定”三段式 qualitative grid 展示语义等价失败；对每个 verdict 同时写状态文本，避免颜色成为唯一证据。

figures.label: Figure 5

caption.text: Figure 5: The consistency between model predictions under pairwise comparison.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝—白—红连续色条表示模型预测一致性 0–1；格内百分比提供数值冗余。

encodings.x: 18 个 evaluator model 的分类列。
encodings.y: 同一 18-model 列表的分类行。
encodings.color: 格值/颜色为 pairwise prediction consistency，0–1 colorbar。
encodings.text: 每格标注一位小数百分比，右侧 colorbar 标 0.0–1.0。

figures.data_and_statistics: 18×18 evaluator-pair consistency matrix（324 cells）；对角线 100%，非对角线大多约 65%–90%，正文概括 pairwise 通常超过 75% 且许多超过 80%。这是跨模型标签一致性 point estimate，无误差、样本量或分母。
figures.evidence_relation: §E.2 的 prediction-distribution consistency → Figure 5 pairwise 矩阵 → Figure 6 single 矩阵；与 Table 3 的 pairwise>single 主张形成跨对象稳健性检查，Figure 7/8 继续拆 rubric 内部与跨方法一致性。
design_strengths: 对称矩阵把所有模型对的相似性放在一个可查表面。
格内百分比和 colorbar 同时编码，避免只靠色差读值。
对角线 100% 提供直观 sanity check。
design_weaknesses: 18×18 标签和旋转 x 标签非常密集，页面缩放后难以定位模型。
diverging 色条在此表示高低而不是 signed effect，语义需要 caption/正文解释；灰度不安全。
没有说明每个 cell 的实例分母或一致性计算公式。
figures.reusable_pattern: 对多模型 prediction agreement 使用对称 heatmap、对角线 sanity check、cell percentage 和右侧 colorbar；模型超过约 10 个时应提供可读标签策略。

caption.text: Figure 6: The consistency between model prediction under single answer grading.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝—白—红色条表示 single-answer prediction consistency；格内百分比冗余编码。

encodings.x: 19 个 evaluator model 的分类列。
encodings.y: 同一 19-model 列表的分类行。
encodings.color: 格值/颜色为 single-answer consistency，0–1 colorbar。
encodings.text: 每格为百分比，斜向模型名和右侧色条提供索引。

figures.data_and_statistics: 19×19 single-answer evaluator consistency matrix（361 cells），比 Figure 5 多 UI-TARS-1.5；非对角线常在约 45%–65%，高值也被逐格写出。无误差、分母或重复信息。
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 5 的 pairwise consistency → Figure 6 的 single-answer 对照 → §E.2 关于 absolute-quality calibration 不一致的解释；Table 14 的 no-tie 结果显示去掉 tie 后 agreement 上升，但不改变此矩阵的模型间对照。
design_strengths: 与 Figure 5 保持同一色条、布局和格内数值语法，便于直接比较范式。
对角线和直接百分比使颜色估读可以被核对。
将 UI-TARS 纳入同一矩阵，连接 vanilla 与 agentic evaluator。
design_weaknesses: 19 个长模型名导致旋转标签和单格文字拥挤。
与 Figure 5 分页，读者需要来回翻页才能比较同一模型对。
caption 没有定义一致性是按何种标签/样本计算，也没有 uncertainty。
figures.reusable_pattern: 保持 pairwise/single heatmap 的相同模型排序和视觉参数，只替换范式；通过逐格数值和统一色条支持跨页差异审阅。

figures.label: Figure 7

caption.text: Figure 7: The inner prediction consistency between model predictions under rubric paradigm.

color.semantic_mapping: 两个 rubric consistency 矩阵使用同一蓝—白—红 0–1 色条；cell 百分比直接显示。

encodings.x: 每个 panel 的 8 个 rubric model 分类列。
encodings.y: 每个 panel 的 8 个 rubric model 分类行。
encodings.text: cell 百分比、(a)/(b) panel caption 和轴标题。

figures.data_and_statistics: 两个 8×8 矩阵（128 cells）：(a) rubric pairwise，(b) rubric single-answer；对角线为 100%，大多数值约 70%–86%。无误差或分母。
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 5/6 的跨 evaluator consistency → Figure 7 的 rubric-only 内部一致性 → Figure 8 的 rubric/direct inter-method consistency；支持“rubric 内部仍有模型差异”而非只归因于 pairwise。
design_strengths: 双 panel 同页提供范式对照，且保留 cell 数值和 colorbar。
矩阵尺寸缩小后仍比 18×18 图可读。
panel 说明直接连接正文的 rubric 内部一致性问题。
design_weaknesses: 两个 panel 各放一个 colorbar，增加重复视觉负担。
caption 未说明 8 个模型名单或一致性定义。
颜色仍不是灰度安全编码，且无样本/不确定性信息。
figures.reusable_pattern: 当全模型矩阵过密时，用较小的 rubric 子集双 panel 对照内部一致性；共享排序并保留直接百分比。

caption.text: Figure 8: The inter-method consistency between model predictions under rubric paradigm and direct paradigm.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝—白—红色条表示 rubric 与 direct prediction 的 inter-method consistency；格内百分比为冗余数值。

encodings.x: 每个 panel x 轴为 7 个 Rubric Models。
encodings.y: 每个 panel y 轴为 7 个 Direct Models。
encodings.color: 格值/颜色为 cross-method consistency，0–1 colorbar。

design_strengths: 明确用 x/y 轴区分 Rubric Models 和 Direct Models，避免把矩阵误读为同一范式。
左右 panel 同页、色条和格值一致。
把“协议差异”从平均 agreement 推进到 pairwise model-level consistency。

caption 没有说明两个 panel 分别对应 pairwise/single，信息只在子图小标题中。
没有给 cell 分母、tie 规则或不确定性。
figures.reusable_pattern: 跨方法一致性适合用非对称角色的 heatmap：在轴标题中明确 reference/evaluator 角色，并为两个范式保持相同配色和排序。

figures.label: Figure 9

caption.text: Figure 9: Examples of the rubric tree structure derived from different sources with corresponding queries. The diagram illustrates human-written rubric trees used for few-shot generation (left), alongside good (center) and suboptimal (right) examples of LLM-generated rubric trees. Note that the children attribute of leaf nodes is explicitly set to null. For conciseness, some internal nodes have been omitted. Leaf nodes are labeled in green.

color.semantic_mapping: 深青 query header、浅蓝虚线 JSON 面板、绿色 leaf-node 文本；绿色是 leaf 的语义编码，且由 JSON 的 children:null 文字配合。

encodings.x: 三个来源示例从左至右：human-written、good generated、suboptimal generated。
encodings.y: 文本树的层级和缩进表示 rubric depth。
encodings.color: 绿色 leaf labels、青色 query headers、浅蓝 panel backgrounds。
encodings.shape: 三列文本框与缩进的 JSON/tree nodes。
encodings.line: 虚线 panel border 分隔三个案例；无流程连接线。

figures.data_and_statistics: 三个 rubric-tree qualitative examples，不报告样本统计；图中省略部分 internal nodes，leaf children 显式为 null。左为人工 few-shot source，中为较好 LLM 生成，右为过细/次优生成。
figures.evidence_relation: Appendix B rubric generation 与 Table 10 tree height/leaf count → Figure 9 展示树粒度如何随 query 变化 → Figure 10 使用右侧 suboptimal rubric 展开 functional-equivalence 失败。
design_strengths: 三列同构面板让人工、good、suboptimal 质量差异可直接比较。
leaf 绿色、query header 和 JSON 字段层级把结构与语义同时留在图内。
caption 明确说明 children:null、内部节点省略和 leaf 颜色，脱离正文仍可解释。
design_weaknesses: 三列 JSON 字幕密集，缩放后需要放大阅读。
绿色 leaf 的语义依赖 caption，灰度下低对比但文本仍存在。
内部节点省略使图不是完整 rubric tree，不能用于复现全部结构。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用三列同构的“来源/质量对照 + 结构化文本”展示生成树质量；对省略节点、叶节点定义和 query 条件在 caption 中显式说明。

evidence.label: p.31 Figure 9 and caption

figures.label: Figure 10

caption.text: Figure 10: Failure cases in functional equivalence identification. While GPT-4.1 correctly identifies equivalence for the specific “Organization” category and the general “categories” requirement given the query, rubric, and instructions, other models like DeepSeek-R1-0528 and UI-TARS-1.5 fail to do so. These models misinterpret the requirements and exhibit hesitation in recognizing the equivalence for general categories.

color.semantic_mapping: 浅绿表示 GPT-4.1 正确识别，浅红表示 DeepSeek/UI-TARS 失败，深色网页截图是实现证据；状态同时用模型名和文字输出编码。

encodings.x: 横向从 query/rubric 到 webpage，再到 GPT-4.1、DeepSeek-R1-0528、UI-TARS 输出。
encodings.y: 垂直层级从要求、实现到模型解释/结论。
encodings.color: 绿色/红色结果框与深色网页 screenshot。
encodings.line: 虚线边界分隔 query、webpage 和 model outputs。
encodings.facet: query+rubic、webpage、三种模型输出五个区域。
encodings.text: Organization/categories、value true/false、模型 thought/action 文本。

figures.data_and_statistics: 以同一 query/rubric 和网页实现比较三种 evaluator：GPT-4.1 对 “Organization” 与一般 “categories” 判等价，DeepSeek-R1-0528 与 UI-TARS-1.5 判错/犹豫。它是代表性 failure case，不给错误比例、分母或不确定性。
figures.evidence_relation: Figure 4 的 Demonstration/Presentation 案例 → Figure 9 右侧 suboptimal rubric → Figure 10 的具体模型解释 → §4.3 functional-equivalence 结论；它是机制性定性证据，不替代总体 error rate。
design_strengths: 同一 requirement、网页和模型输出在一个画布中，能定位错误来自语义匹配而非输入缺失。
绿色/红色状态、模型名和 true/false 输出形成冗余编码。
截图与原始 reasoning/action 文本互补，支持案例级复核。
design_weaknesses: 多个长 response block 造成高信息密度，阅读顺序需依赖面板边界。
状态颜色在灰度下不安全，caption 虽有文字结论但没有简化的结果汇总表。
案例没有 prevalence 或抽样规则，不能量化 failure mode 的权重。
figures.reusable_pattern: 将一个 failure case 组织为 query/rubric → implementation screenshot → model outputs，并给正确/错误输出使用文字与背景色双编码。

evidence.label: p.32 Figure 10 and caption

figures.label: Figure 11

caption.text: Figure 11: Failure case in feasibility analysis due to operation error. The agentic evaluator fails to detect the target ‘regenerate’ element in the provided screenshot, resulting in an incorrect assessment of the task as infeasible.

color.semantic_mapping: 深色 UI screenshot 表示 web state，蓝色按钮/输入控件来自页面，浅红 response 区表示 UI-TARS 的错误 infeasible 结论；文字说明同步表达失败。

encodings.x: 左右两个区域：Webpage screenshot 与 UI-TARS-1.5 thought/action。
encodings.y: 上方 task header、下方 screen/response 层级。
encodings.color: 深色网页、蓝色控件和浅红 model response。
encodings.line: 虚线边界分隔 task、webpage 和 agent response。

figures.data_and_statistics: 网页截图中已有 AI message 及目标 regenerate 控件，但 UI-TARS-1.5 的操作叙述没有定位该元素并将任务判为 infeasible；没有总体导航失败率或不确定性。
figures.evidence_relation: Table 6 的 agent precision/recall trade-off → Figure 11 的 UI operation failure → §4.3 对 interactive navigation/state interpretation 的解释；与 Figure 10 的 semantic equivalence failure 组成两类定性 failure evidence。
design_strengths: 页面截图和 agent thought/action 并列，能把“真实网页缺陷”和“代理操作错误”区分开。
失败结论在浅红面板和 `failed` 文本中双重出现。
caption 直接给出错误机制和错误评估结果。
design_weaknesses: 模型长文本占据右栏，核心控件在截图中较小。
颜色把 response 结果突出，但对灰度读者不友好。
单案例不说明 UI-TARS 失败的发生率、任务抽样或可重复性。
figures.reusable_pattern: 对 agent failure 使用“任务—网页状态—thought/action”三块并列，确保操作错误有可见的页面证据而不是只有模型自述。

evidence.label: p.32 Figure 11 and caption

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1: Annotation agreement rates with and without the verifiable rubric. The ‘without rubric’ part shows agreements between: (1) annotators and (2) annotators and the original labels. The ‘with rubric’ part shows inter-annotator agreements under human-written and LLM-generated rubrics.

tables.data_and_statistics: Agreement-rate point estimates for a 100-instance re-annotation sample; “w/ tie” includes the third tie label and “w/o tie” removes tie cases. No error bars, interval estimates, repeats, or denominator counts are shown.
tables.evidence_relation: Raw annotation subjectivity → rubric-guided re-annotation → Table 1 agreement lift → generated rubric used for the remaining benchmark; Figure 1 middle column provides the rubric interface.
design_strengths: Two-level grouped header makes without/with rubric contrast explicit.
The w/ tie and w/o tie rows expose tie sensitivity rather than hiding it.
One compact table gives inter-annotator and annotator-origin comparisons together.
design_weaknesses: The caption does not state the 100-instance sample size; it is only in surrounding text.
Vertical separators plus grouped headers are readable but not a pure booktabs grammar.
Point estimates have no task-level dispersion or adjudication information.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a two-level header for protocol families and keep tie-inclusive/exclusive rows adjacent when annotation quality is the claim.

evidence.label: p.4 Table 1 native table and caption

tables.label: Table 2

caption.text: Table 2: Categories and their respective sub-categories of queries in WebDevJudge.

tables.data_and_statistics: Three query-category groups and their listed sub-categories; Total % is 34.0, 34.4, and 31.6. These are distribution percentages, not uncertainty intervals.
tables.evidence_relation: Benchmark domain-coverage setup → Table 2 category taxonomy → Figure 2 sorted sub-category bars; the totals establish the denominator context for later per-category Table 3 agreement.
design_strengths: Category, sub-category list, and total are aligned in one compact taxonomy table.
Uppercase/small-caps group labels make three top-level domains easy to scan.
The adjacent Figure 2 provides a numeric view of all sub-categories.
design_weaknesses: Long sub-category lists create uneven row heights.
Caption does not state whether percentages use 654 instances or source queries; surrounding text is needed.
The table has no counts, so 34.0/34.4/31.6 cannot be independently reconstructed from the object alone.
tables.reusable_pattern: Pair a concise taxonomy table with a sorted distribution chart, retaining the same labels and denominator note in the surrounding text.

evidence.label: p.5 Table 2 native table and caption

tables.label: Table 3

caption.text: Table 3: Agreement Rate (%) of different evaluators under different evaluation paradigms. The best average performance of the whole dataset is highlighted in bold and the second best is underlined.

tables.data_and_statistics: Agreement-rate percentages are point estimates over the relevant benchmark instances; dashes indicate agentic rows do not use pairwise grading. No confidence interval, standard error, seed dispersion, or task-level count is shown.
tables.evidence_relation: Main evaluator capability question → Table 3 model/category/paradigm matrix → Figure 3 protocol comparison and Tables 4–7 diagnostic slices. GPT-4.1 pairwise average is 70.34 versus human pairwise 84.56; Claude-4-Sonnet 70.18 is underlined as second-best average.
design_strengths: The 9-column matrix keeps model, three categories, average, and single/pair axes in one object.
Gray group bands distinguish Vanilla/non-reasoning/reasoning, Agentic, and Human baselines.
Bold/underline directly identify the best and second-best whole-dataset averages.
design_weaknesses: Very dense 22-row table and long model names reduce scan speed.
The caption does not define tie treatment, category denominators, or why some model names carry icons.
Single and pair columns contain no uncertainty or cost dimension, so reliability is represented by one aggregate only.
tables.reusable_pattern: For a benchmark headline, use a multi-level model×category×paradigm matrix with group bands and explicit best/second-best rules; move dispersion and denominator details to a companion artifact.

evidence.label: p.6 Table 3 native table and caption

tables.label: Table 4

caption.text: Table 4: Impact of observation forms on the performance of multimodal evaluators. The numbers in parentheses indicate the performance change relative to the setting with both code and image inputs.

tables.data_and_statistics: Agreement-rate point estimates for five multimodal models under six observation/paradigm cells. Parenthetical colored arrows are signed changes from Both code+image, not uncertainty.
tables.evidence_relation: Observation-modality question → Table 4 Image Only/Code Only/Both contrast → claim that code is generally more critical while both modalities help pairwise evaluation; Figure 3 supplies guidance context.
design_strengths: Two top-level paradigm headers and repeated Image Only/Code Only/Both columns make the intervention explicit.
Green/red arrows and text distinguish direction and magnitude of changes.
Rows align the same models across single and pairwise settings.
design_weaknesses: Colored arrow text is not grayscale-safe and values mix base scores with deltas in the same cell.
Caption defines the reference but not the exact denominator or tie handling.
No visual summary of the cross-row pattern; readers must compare 30 cells.
tables.reusable_pattern: Represent modality ablations as repeated condition triplets with the full-input baseline in the third column and signed deltas in parentheses.

evidence.label: p.8 Table 4 native table and caption

tables.label: Table 5

caption.text: Table 5: Positional bias in pairwise comparison. Preference for specific position, consistency and the absolute difference in agreement rate (∆ AR) between original and swapped orders are reported.

tables.data_and_statistics: For Claude-4-sonnet, GPT-4.1, and DeepSeek-V3-0324, reports position consistency, first/second preference percentages, and absolute Δ AR between original and swapped orders under Direct/Likert. These are point estimates; no uncertainty or pair counts.
tables.evidence_relation: Position-bias claim → Table 5 consistency and first/second preference → Figure 4 equivalence case and Appendix Table 13 swap mitigation. The table supports an inherent-bias diagnosis but not a causal prevalence estimate.
design_strengths: Four metric families are grouped under Consistency, First, Second, and Δ AR.
Direct/Likert subheaders preserve protocol symmetry.
Including both position preference and swapped-order Δ AR separates bias direction from agreement change.
design_weaknesses: The caption uses Δ AR without defining the subtraction direction.
Only three models are shown and no sample sizes appear.
The table does not visually flag the largest bias values, so the reader must scan decimals.
tables.reusable_pattern: For order-bias audits, put direction, consistency, and original-vs-swapped change in adjacent grouped columns rather than a single bias score.

evidence.label: p.8 Table 5 native table and caption

tables.label: Table 6

caption.text: Table 6: Performance on the WebDevJudge-Unit for feasibility verification. We report precision (P), recall (R), F1-score, and accuracy (Acc).

tables.data_and_statistics: Feasibility classification over the 502-task WebDevJudge-Unit dataset (279 feasible, 223 infeasible): UI-TARS-1.5 trajectory, GPT-4.1 code, and DeepSeek-V3 code report P/R/F1/Acc. No intervals or task-level dispersion.
tables.evidence_relation: Feasibility-verification bottleneck → Table 6 precision/recall trade-off → Figure 11 operation failure and gated ensemble Table 7. Agent has higher precision (82.4) but lower recall (70.3), while code LLMs show the reverse tendency.
design_strengths: P/R/F1/Acc are conventional and compact, with Observe exposing trajectory versus code input.
The narrow table sits beside the explanatory error-analysis text.
The four metrics make the complementary failure pattern visible without a separate plot.
design_weaknesses: Caption only defines abbreviations; it does not state 502 tasks or 279/223 labels.
Rows mix an agent and two code-only models without a visual group header.
No confusion counts or uncertainty reveal how the trade-off arises.
tables.reusable_pattern: Keep feasibility metrics in a compact model×observation×P/R/F1/Acc table and pair it with a qualitative operation-failure case.

evidence.label: p.9 Table 6 native table and caption

tables.label: Table 7

caption.text: Table 7: Performance comparison between single LLM and the agent-integrated ensemble.

tables.data_and_statistics: Four agreement point estimates: GPT-4.1 65.0→66.2 and DeepSeek-V3-0324 66.3→67.6 after adding UI-TARS-1.5; no uncertainty or gate error decomposition.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 6 P/R complementarity and Eq. (2) Agent ∨ LLM → Table 7 single LLM versus agent-integrated ensemble → conclusion that dynamic verification gives a small finite-model gain.
design_strengths: The two-column table isolates the decision-relevant before/after comparison.
Indented +UI-TARS-1.5 rows make the ensemble addition visible.
Placement beside the Eq. (2) discussion keeps the gate close to its result.
design_weaknesses: The indented rows are not a formal row-group header and can be mistaken for separate models.
The caption does not state that the values are agreement rates or explain the gate.
Only two base models are tested, and no false-positive/false-negative breakdown is shown.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a minimal before/after table for an ensemble addition, but label the base and added components in a structured column rather than indentation alone.

evidence.label: p.10 Table 7 native table and caption

tables.label: Table 8

caption.text: Table 8: Overview of the filtering pipeline, including the number of instances before and after filtering, and the purpose of each filtering stage.

tables.data_and_statistics: Filtering counts are integer before/after stages: 10,501→6,730→2,460→1,814→1,713→700→654. Purpose text documents query, environment, sampling, and manual annotation filters; no uncertainty.
tables.evidence_relation: Main §3.1 two-stage filtering claim → Appendix Table 8 complete count chain → 654-instance benchmark and Table 2 distribution. It restores the denominator and attrition that the main text only summarizes.
design_strengths: A four-column schema keeps stage, count transition, and rationale adjacent.
Repeated Query-based/Env-based prefixes preserve the causal filtering order.
The full before/after chain makes data loss auditable.
design_weaknesses: Long purpose cells wrap into dense rows and require full-width placement.
Counts do not include percentages or retained-rate calculations.
The caption does not state the final 654 value explicitly; it must be read from the last row.
tables.reusable_pattern: For dataset construction, show every irreversible filter as a before→after row with a short purpose rather than reporting only the final sample.

evidence.label: p.16 Table 8 native table and caption

tables.label: Table 9

caption.text: Table 9: Examples of problematic cases. In each example, the upper figure is referred to as model_a, while the lower one is model_b.

tables.data_and_statistics: Two qualitative problematic cases: Apple-like website with subjective label bias, and 4×8 game 2048 with a both-bad tie/misjudgment. Each Implementation cell stacks upper model_a and lower model_b screenshots; no prevalence.
tables.evidence_relation: Raw preference-label subjectivity → Table 9 screenshot pairs and analysis reasons → rubric annotation pipeline/Table 1 agreement lift. This is qualitative evidence for filtering, not a rate estimate.
design_strengths: Query, implementation, and analysis columns separate prompt, rendered evidence, and adjudication.
Upper/lower screenshot convention is stated in the caption.
Analysis text records why the original label is judged problematic rather than only showing screenshots.
design_weaknesses: Embedded screenshots are small and stack two cases within a tall table.
The caption does not define “subjective label bias” or “bothbad” for a reader outside Appendix B.
No count of how often either problem type occurs is supplied.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a three-column case table to bind a natural-language query to paired renderings and an explicit adjudication reason; add prevalence when making distributional claims.

evidence.label: p.19 Table 9 native table and caption

tables.label: Table 10

caption.text: Table 10: Statistics of the generated rubric trees.

tables.data_and_statistics: Average rubric-tree height and average number of leaf nodes for Intention, Static, Dynamic, and Whole: heights 2.0/3.9/3.3/5.0 and leaves 3.6/15.6/10.6/29.9. No distribution or uncertainty.
tables.evidence_relation: Generated rubric construction → Table 10 structural complexity summary → Figure 9 human/good/suboptimal tree examples and agent settings in Table 11.
design_strengths: The Whole column gives a compact aggregate beside dimension-specific structure.
Two simple rows make tree depth versus leaf breadth easy to compare.
Metric names are explicit rather than hiding complexity in a single score.
design_weaknesses: Title-only caption omits that values are averages and which dimensions are included.
No min/max or spread indicates how much rubric complexity varies by query.
The narrow table depends on Appendix B prose for interpretation.
tables.reusable_pattern: Summarize generated hierarchical artifacts with separate depth and leaf-count rows, retaining dimension and whole-tree columns.

evidence.label: p.19 Table 10 native table and caption

tables.label: Table 11

caption.text: Table 11: Details of the agent settings.

tables.data_and_statistics: Agent settings for Static, Dynamic, and Intention: input/output formats and max steps (6; 5 basic/15 complex; 15). These are fixed protocol limits, not performance uncertainty.
tables.evidence_relation: Eq. (1) planner–executor–summarizer → Table 11 interface and step budget → Table 6 feasibility outcomes and Figure 11 navigation failure. It is the reproduction boundary for the agentic evaluator.
design_strengths: Input and output formats are placed next to the dimension, exposing the contract.
Max Step is a dedicated column and retains the dynamic basic/complex distinction.
The table is adjacent to the UI-TARS action-space box.
design_weaknesses: Title-only caption gives no clue that rows are input/output/step contracts.
Long prose in the Dynamic row wraps and compresses the table.
The table has no model version, seed, timeout, or success-rate context.
tables.reusable_pattern: Document agentic protocols as dimension×input×output×budget, with variable budgets written explicitly rather than averaged.

evidence.label: p.23 Table 11 native table and caption

tables.label: Table 12

caption.text: Table 12: Statistics of the WebDevJudge-Unit dataset.

tables.data_and_statistics: Eight infeasible-task error types with proportions 35.9, 30.9, 15.2, 9.0, 5.4, 2.2, 0.9, 0.5; Example has Task/Expected Result, and Error Reason gives qualitative causes. Percentages sum to 100.0.
tables.evidence_relation: WebDevJudge-Unit construction → Table 12 error taxonomy and examples → Table 6 P/R/F1/Acc and Figure 11 operation failure. It links aggregate feasibility to concrete label categories.
design_strengths: Proportion, example description, and error reason share one row, preserving mechanism context.
Bold Task/Expected Result labels help scan long qualitative cells.
The taxonomy totals 100%, making the infeasible subset auditable.
design_weaknesses: Five-column table is very dense and the Error Reason column is narrow.
Caption is title-only and does not state that proportions refer to infeasible tasks.
No counts per error type are shown, only percentages.
tables.reusable_pattern: Pair a failure taxonomy percentage with one task/expected-result example and an explicit reason, while stating the conditioning subset in the caption.

evidence.label: p.26 Table 12 native table and caption

tables.label: Table 13

caption.text: Table 13: Agreement rate (%) with and without mitigating the positional bias.

tables.data_and_statistics: Agreement-rate percentages for Claude-4-sonnet, GPT-4.1, and DeepSeekV3-0324 with/without positional-bias mitigation under Direct/Likert. Values are 68.6/68.3 vs 70.0/70.2, 68.8/68.3 vs 68.7/70.3, and 64.2/64.4 vs 66.7/67.1. No uncertainty.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 5 raw position bias → Appendix Table 13 swap-each-pair mitigation → text conclusion that debiasing changes aggregate performance modestly and is not used in the main single-pass benchmark.
design_strengths: Two-level header makes mitigation status and protocol explicit.
The compact table supports a before/after ablation without mixing unrelated models.
Values are close enough to show why aggregate mitigation is not a decisive improvement.
design_weaknesses: Caption does not state that inconsistent swapped choices become ties.
The narrow table has no bold/arrow to mark direction or magnitude.
No sample count or uncertainty distinguishes small changes from noise.
tables.reusable_pattern: For a debiasing check, use paired condition blocks and preserve the raw single-pass baseline rather than reporting only the mitigated score.

evidence.label: p.27 Table 13 native table and caption

tables.label: Table 14

caption.text: Table 14: Agreement Rate (%) (without tie) of different evaluators under different evaluation paradigms.

tables.data_and_statistics: No-tie agreement percentages for 17 Likert rows and 9 Rubric/Agentic rows across three categories and Single/Pair columns. Example: GPT-4.1 Likert average 69.72/83.49 and Rubric average 74.50/81.28. No uncertainty or counts.
tables.evidence_relation: Main Table 3 tie-inclusive agreement → Appendix Table 14 no-tie slice → claim that pairwise remains stronger and Rubric improves single-answer grading when ties are removed.
design_strengths: The Likert and Rubric gray bands separate protocol families while reusing Table 3’s column skeleton.
Category and average columns make within-category versus overall shifts visible.
Bold/underline styling carries the main-table best/second-best convention into the ablation.
design_weaknesses: 26 data rows and 9 columns make this appendix table difficult to scan.
Caption does not define that “without tie” changes the denominator.
Mixed one/two decimal display and absent counts limit statistical interpretation.
tables.reusable_pattern: Reuse the main result table’s column grammar for tie-sensitivity slices, so readers can compare protocol effects without relearning the layout.

evidence.label: p.30 Table 14 native table and caption

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 的 data→rubric annotation→judge 方法接口先行；Tables 1–2 定义标签质量和 query coverage；Table 3 给出模型/类别/paradigm headline；Figure 3、Table 4 控制 guidance 与 observation；Table 5、Figure 4、Tables 6–7 拆解 bias、functional equivalence、feasibility 与 ensemble；Appendix Tables 8–14、Figures 5–11 补齐过滤、树复杂度、agent contract、consistency、tie sensitivity 和案例。
cross_object_system.caption_system: Figure/Table 标签均使用普通 roman 的“Figure n:”或“Table n:”开头，没有统一粗体结论标题。主文 Figure 1/3、Table 1/3–6 caption 会说明设置、比较或编码；Table 10–14 和 Figure 5–8 多为标题/对象说明，几乎不定义分母和不确定性；Figure 4/10/11 明确写出案例级 failure。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 主结果表复用“Model/Method + category × Single/Pair + Average”的多级表头；Table 4 使用 Single Answer Grading/Pairwise Comparison × Image/Code/Both；附录用灰色 group bands、部分竖分隔线和 booktabs-like 横线。最佳值一般用 bold，Table 3/14 再用 underline 标 second best。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 1 中栏/右栏定义 rubric、observation 和 paradigm；Table 3 是主结果；Figure 3/Table 4 进行 guidance/modality 控制；Table 5/13 处理 position bias；Figure 4/10/11 和 Table 6 展示 semantic/operation failure；Table 7 测试 Agent ∨ LLM；Figures 5–8/Table 14 提供一致性与 no-tie 变体。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文以 Appendix B/C/D/E/F 指针调用过滤计数、rubric 统计、agent settings、Unit taxonomy、swap/no-tie consistency 和 case studies；PDF 实际 Table 11 在物理 p.23，reading inventory 标为 p.22，本审计以 PDF 页面为准。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: native table 和正文使用嵌入 Nimbus Roman No9 L、Computer Modern math，表头 bold/italic 稳定；图内流程、heatmap 和截图分别使用 DejaVu Sans、Arial/Calibri/Comic Sans/monospace，字体家族和字号混合。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Figure 1/4/9–11 反复使用深蓝、浅蓝、粉/绿状态色；Figure 2/3 的 pastel bars 仅在各图内有效；Figure 5–8 统一蓝白红 colorbar；表格大多黑白，Table 4 的红/绿箭头是唯一显著的表格色语义。整体颜色角色可追踪，但不是单一全局 palette。

most_reusable_patterns: Figure 1 的三栏 data→annotation→judge 流程，将方法组件、观察模态和评测范式放在一个接口图中。
Table 3 的 model×category×single/pair 多级表头与 group bands，适合在一个 headline table 中保留异质性。
Figure 3 的直接标注 grouped bars、Table 4 的完整输入基线+括号 delta，以及 Figures 5–8 的 cell percentage+colorbar 冗余编码。
Figure 4/10/11 的 requirement/implementation/model-output qualitative grid，把抽象 failure mode 绑定到可检查证据。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1：最有效的方法接口总览，直接连接 data quality、rubric tree 和 evaluator protocol。
Table 3：主 headline，量化 LLM/agent/human gap、category heterogeneity 与 single/pair 差异。
Table 4 与 Table 6：分别把 observation modality 和 feasibility precision–recall trade-off 放到可决策的列结构中。
Figure 4、Figure 10、Figure 11：把 functional-equivalence 与操作失败从抽象文字变成可复核案例。
failure_patterns: 公开仓库只有 Figure 1 的 rendered overview asset，没有可重建所有图表的 plot/table/TeX 源；不能把 evaluator code 当作视觉源。
Table 10–14 与 Figure 5–8 的 caption 多为标题或对象名，分母、tie 规则、cell 计算和不确定性需回到正文/附录。
热图、长模型名、JSON rubric 和模型 response 在单页缩放下密集；多数颜色语义灰度不安全。
案例图有效说明机制，但没有 failure prevalence、抽样规则或 task-level dispersion，不能替代总体错误率。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 以单栏 Letter 页面中的流程总览和 grouped tables 建立 benchmark 主线，再用直接标注条形图、蓝白红一致性矩阵和 requirement–screenshot–model-output 案例把 protocol 差异与三类 evaluator failure 逐层绑定，但把分母与不确定性留在正文/附录文字而非图表本身。
